gui_forms::Button.summary: Button specializes ButtonBase with accept/cancel dialog results, default-button state, four public visual policies, bounded flat-border width, and event ordering that commits dialog state before command publication.
remarks: Publishes `clicked` after committing any non-None `DialogResult` to the owning Window. `DialogResult` uses the exact WinForms numeric values and undefined gaps are rejected.
`Window::set_accept_button` transfers the default-button cue; Enter and Escape route to live accept/cancel targets only after the focused route declines the key.
`perform_click()` (inherited) uses the same availability and validation gate as mnemonic and dialog commands. Four public visual styles and a bounded flat-border width are retained.
gui_forms::Button.ownership: Created by the application as a `Control::Ptr` (`std::shared_ptr<Control>`). A parent holds its children strongly and a child holds its parent weakly; cycles, duplicate stable IDs, cross-window reparenting, and disposed children are rejected. Disposal through `Component::dispose()` is synchronous and idempotent and revokes owned subscriptions before subclass teardown.
gui_forms::Button.threading: UI-thread affine. Read and mutate on the owning Window's UI thread; wrong-thread mutation is rejected by the Window access guards (`Window::check_access` and `Window::verify_access`). The type is not internally synchronized.
gui_forms::Button.availability: Renderer-neutral core (`gui_forms_controls`). Available wherever the GUI.Forms core builds: the macOS AppKit host, the Windows Win32 host, and the opt-in Linux X11 host. The public API is not yet stable.

gui_forms::Button::Button|void (StableId.summary: Constructs a ButtonBase with standard visual policy and no dialog result.

gui_forms::Button::dialog_result_changed.summary: Returns the event published after dialog result commits.

gui_forms::Button::on_paint|void (Painte.summary: Resolves the selected visual role/style and records default/focus/content cues.
